headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler_reference
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t =
    ⟨Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t,
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWord xs ys htotal hb t⟩

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (t : ℕ),
  ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridWordLaw xs ys htotal t)
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
    ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridWord_feasible
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (t : ℕ)
  (bits : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t).fst → Bool),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.HasMargins (↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t).snd bits))
    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys)
